I'll proceed using Standard 2 TB, Plus 10 TB, Premium 50 TB and prices $9.99, $19.99, $39.99. Compute file size: 60 files put us 100GB over 2TB. So 60 files total = 2TB + 100GB = 2,100GB. Each file = 2,100 / 60 = 35GB.
Total files = 1,040. Total storage needed = 1,040 × 35GB = 36,400GB = 36.4TB. Minimum plan to store all = Premium (50TB).
Files above Standard limit: Standard can store 2,000GB / 35GB ≈ 57 files; over-limit files = 1,040 − 57 = 983.
Now, because both Standard and Plus cannot store all files, the relevant incremental upgrade cost to reach a sufficient plan is from Plus to Premium: $39.99 − $19.99 = $20. Spread that over the 983 files exceeding the Standard limit: 20 / 983 ≈ 0.02036. Rounded to nearest cent: 0.02.
